sources.classification: labelled from the task code, 2026-10-10: a transformer language model trained from scratch, so `ai_training`; precision fp16 (autocast and gradient scaler); params counted from the layer shapes = 519 963 095 = embedding 274 160 640 (267 735 tokens x 1024, tied with the output weights) + output bias 267 735 + 18 layers x 13 640 704 + relative-position biases 2 048 (vocabulary 267 735: WikiText-103 training tokens and <eos>, not counted on the stand's machine); seq_len = target length (the memory adds 256 more positions of context); the run is bounded by max_step 40, not by epochs: epochs and dataset_samples are left out
